name: ACBL Standard American Yellow Card (from the ACBL SAYC system booklet)

provenance.source: ACBL SAYC System Booklet (form SP3, revised January 2006), read through a public copy at https://zfelleg.useribm.hu/bridge/sayc_book.pdf; the card itself (https://bridgeclub.gtorg.gatech.edu/SAYJ/Info/SAYC/sayc_card.pdf) was also read but its text extraction loses the layout and most ranges
provenance.reader: bill (Gen 9), 12 November 2026, by the intake procedure in docs/gen9/card-intake.md

medium: open.strong_2c (22+ 'or playing equivalent': ltc clause is our reading)
low: open.minor: suit symbols are missing in the source text; set to the usual SAYC rule (1D with 4-4, 1C with 3-3), not confirmed by the text read
rebid.one_nt: the booklet gives minimum hands as 13-15 points including distribution; HCP range not stated, set to 12-14
rebid.two_nt: the booklet's maximum is 19-21/22 points for all maximum rebids; set to 18-19 HCP, the gap left by the 15-17 1NT and 20-21 2NT openings

carding_read.when: 12 November 2026 (bill and sam), for the situation fields of G9-D6

printed.attitude: high encourages, low discourages (when following suit or discarding)
printed.count: High-low is an even number, low-high is odd when count is given

high: first_discard attitude: the booklet applies attitude "when following suit or discarding"

three_small_lead_vs_suit low, three_small_lead_vs_nt top ("From three low cards against a suit contract lead low; against notrump contract lead high"), four_small_lead second (from four or more without an honour, "lead the second highest card")
medium: signal_on_partner_lead attitude, signal_on_declarer_lead count: the booklet does not say where each signal applies; placed by the standard priority (sam, from the zaremba.ch SAYC summary and general references)
not_placed: trump signals and suit preference: not stated in the booklet (trump_signal left out, read as Gen 8 reads it)
preempts: sound at equal or unfavourable vulnerability, rule of 2-3-4 by vulnerability (no field)
strong jump shifts by responder invite slam (no field)
takeout doubles are penalty over game-level openings (no field)
after interference over 1NT conventions are off, cue-bid is Stayman (no field)
Grand Slam Force, 5NT king ask (no field)
lead from three low and from four without an honour: placed since sam's lead fields v1.1 (96716fb), see carding_read
